title: [ingest] Auto-wire context-edge threshold is 0.25 (not 0.6)
summary: DEFAULT_AUTOWIRE_THRESHOLD = 0.25: a newly-seen task auto-gets a weighted context edge to each context-eligible match scoring >= this. Note it is far lower than the 0.6 dup threshold — wiring context is deliberately generous, flagging duplicates is conservative. Overridable via config.autowire_threshold.
